message.reasoning_content: Describe: contract, kernel, risks. Key risk: FP32 internal arithmetic with tolerance 1e-7+5e-7|target| — catastrophic cancellation in imag numerator b*c - a*d when nearly equal; FP32 rounding of intermediate products may exceed tolerance for small results. Also N=131072 exceeds grid? cdiv(131072,256)=512 blocks, fine. Denominator squared in FP32 can overflow: c up to 65504, c*c ≈ 4.29e9 overflows... FP32 max ~3.4e38, so c*c ~4.3e9 fine, but scale up to 8.6e9 fine; but result finite? If c,d large and a,b small, result tiny — fine. But intermediate c*c fine in FP32. Real risk: precision of FP32 dot products when numerator components large (65504): a*c ~ 4.3e9, and result requires 1e-7+5e-7*|target|; cancellation may produce relative error > tolerance for small results. Also make_inputs numerator from randn ~ small; adversarial inputs with extreme components not covered. Also storing FP32 outputs — output dtype matches contract. Also validate_inputs is_neg check—contiguous views with nonzero storage offsets: is_contiguous() True; tl.load base pointers use data_ptr which accounts for storage offset — fine. Note mask other=1 for c but d other=0 — harmless for inactive lanes. tl.div_rn needs enable_fp_fusion=False? fine.
